Name: DE-Taxes
Statement:
select  com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        vat.Oid as TaxId,
        vat.Name as Tax,
        vat.Percentage,
        vat.Active as IsActive,
        vat.ExternalId,
        vat.[Default]
from    vat
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = vat.Company
